evidence.title: 5dive readme
evidence.locator: Core architecture; Create agents; Hire teams; Ask/tell/task; Loops; Security
evidence.finding: 5dive runs coding-agent CLIs as persistent Linux/systemd services with own subscriptions/keys and a shared SQLite task queue. It supplies team roles and agent messaging, recurring tasks and external triggers. The optional app can link to a self-hosted server for free.

evidence.title: 5dive docs/guide.md
evidence.locator: How it works; Agent types table; Security/isolation; Accounts
evidence.finding: The exact agent-type guide documents Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, OpenCode and Pi CLI routes, with separate OAuth/API/provider modes. Each agent runs as a Linux user. Core self-hosting and optional app linking are distinct scopes.

evidence.title: 5dive prompts/team-CLAUDE.md
evidence.locator: Teammates; Your role; routed owner asks; --tell-me/task watch result return
evidence.finding: The shipped instructions teach agents to find and message teammates with the product CLI. A supplied lead role routes work and reports to the owner; --tell-me or task watch wakes it on completion, with results returned to the owner rather than provider-native subagents.

evidence.title: 5dive src/lib/tasks_db.sh
evidence.locator: tasks table id/ident/project/title/body/status/priority/assignee; task_sessions and task_deps tables
evidence.finding: The product has its own persistent SQLite task records, IDs, assignment, state, dependencies and separate session records. This is not only a list of agent chats.

evidence.title: 5dive docs/triggers.md
evidence.locator: Signed event triggers; GitHub/webhook config; queue boundary; operations/security
evidence.finding: Signed GitHub and generic webhook requests are verified and deduplicated, then create ordinary queue tasks. The receiver itself does not launch an agent; heartbeat routing dispatches the queued work. The receiver is self-hosted and needs a supervisor/HTTPS proxy.

evidence.title: 5dive SECURITY.md
evidence.locator: What leaves your server; optional app link; signed releases
evidence.finding: For the unlinked server, the security policy calls the core no-telemetry but explicitly discloses an optional --report-import pack-name counter, off unless the flag is used. The linked app has a separate data-processing scope, including agent/settings/chat traffic and optional E2E encryption.

evidence.title: 5dive src/cmd_pack.sh
evidence.locator: _report_import lines38-51; report_import=0; --report-import parser; conditional call near4381
evidence.finding: The code initializes report_import=0 and only sets it for --report-import. After a public registry import, that flag gates a POST of the pack slug to the vendor import counter. This is opt-in usage reporting, not unconditional absence of all telemetry.

evidence.title: 5dive LICENSE
evidence.finding: The inspected core CLI source is MIT-licensed. This pass does not establish the source/license or telemetry parity of the optional hosted/native app clients.
